controls: M4A1 and L115 match site source values exactly as IEEE float32, including damage, rate/model, capacity, reload, velocity, gravity and drag.

inference: Field/source-formula meaning transfers. Native selection, cooldown, target/material composition and availability do not transfer.
unresolved: Effective utility mechanics and projectile owners without exact infantry schema counterparts remain unconfirmed.
Season 5 durability and named AA/mine rows are excluded.
siteImpact: Research classification only; no site values changed.

leads.title: Gadget and vehicle field transfer census
leads.summary: Confirmed infantry field meaning transfers only through the same owner class, descriptor key and field; effective gadget and vehicle behavior remains separate.
leads.reopenWhen: A named unconfirmed field receives exact schema and independent semantic evidence.
